case.name: update_blob_after_points
case.sql: UPDATE t SET payload=CAST(substr(payload,1,length(payload)-1)||'x' AS BLOB) WHERE t.id BETWEEN 35996 AND 101531;
case.prepare: WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM c WHERE i<1000) SELECT sum((SELECT v FROM t WHERE id=1+(c.i*2654435761)%262144)) FROM c;
